_doc: list-queue-discards: entity-set fidelity against the F7 discarding fixtures. Monitoring's helpers.sh provisions three queues that actively discard messages: test-queue-discards-spool (spool quota exceeded), test-queue-discards-ttl (TTL-expired), and test-queue-lowprio-congestion (low-priority reject). The tool's summary emits topOffenderQueues[] with those names when discards are non-zero. Ground truth: extract queueName from topOffenderQueues, require the same set appears in the answer. A model that hedges 'no discards' fails against a fixture that actively discards. Broker-a only — same fixtures on broker-b. Fabrication check runs against the raw tool_result (see run-scenario.sh), so an adjacent test-queue-* the model mentions for context is not flagged. TIMING: topOffenderQueues[] is only populated once F7 has actually discarded — setup.cmd polls the three discard counters until all are non-zero before turn 1, so the assertion doesn't race the fixture warm-up.
prompt: Are any queues in the default VPN dropping messages on $BROKER?
